title: Show HN: Open-Source Greptile Alternative
summary: Juror is an open-source alternative to Greptile, designed to provide code search, indexing, and analysis capabilities for developers. It appears to be a Hacker News launched project aimed at offering a free, self-hostable solution for codebase intelligence.
problem_solved: Provides an open-source, self-hostable alternative for code search and codebase analysis without vendor lock-in or subscription costs.
why_valuable: Offers developers full control over their code intelligence infrastructure with transparency of source code, making it ideal for privacy-conscious teams or those wanting to self-host.
